notes: Bulk islet RNA cannot separate beta-cell identity loss from a change in beta-cell abundance or exocrine contamination.
IDENTITY_CORE_v1 genes (INS, IAPP, PDX1, MAFA, PCSK1, ...) are NOT used as the abundance covariate, because that adjustment is circular.
These short panels are literature islet/exocrine markers that do not overlap IDENTITY_CORE_v1 or STRESS_CORE_v1.
Marker means are not cell-type deconvolution.

BETA_ABUNDANCE_PROXY_v1.source: Short adult beta-cell markers outside IDENTITY_CORE_v1. G6PC2, INSM1, SCGN, and SYT13 are in HALLMARK_PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS (Liberzon et al. 2015) and are not in the locked 21-gene identity core.

EXOCRINE_CONTAMINATION_PROXY_v1.source: Canonical acinar/exocrine transcripts used as a bulk-islet purity/contamination proxy (trypsin, carboxypeptidase A1, elastase, amylase, chymotrypsin).

ENDOCRINE_NONBETA_PROXY_v1.source: Alpha, delta, and PP hormones as a non-beta endocrine composition proxy. GCG and SST are in HALLMARK_PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS but are not beta-cell identity genes and are not in IDENTITY_CORE_v1.
